description: Record high, record low and highest recent level at one Environment Agency gauge, with how far today's level is below the record. Answers "is this a record flood" for journalists, residents and property buyers. Source: Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring API (station stage scale). Records only cover the years the gauge has operated, and some gauges publish none. (cost: 1 credit)

station_id.description: string, required, Environment Agency station reference, e.g. 1491TH (Kings Mill, Oxford)

name: river_level_record
